raw_response:
This small plot is only a tiny piece of my land, just a little garden really, so I will not spend much cash on it. I keep some animals, so I can spread manure from the kraal — that costs me nothing. I will use my own local seed that I saved from last harvest, and my daughter and I can manage the weeding by hand without hiring anyone. There is no irrigation here; we wait for the rains like always.
